programme.desc: We spent a day in snowy Austria with rally professional Niki Schelle in a Suzuki SX4 S-Cross. Also: why is the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution perfect for drifting? And: Mercedes and Chrysler present their all-wheel concept cars.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We show how to have a lot of fun on gravel roads in a Subaru WRX STI. Also: in the 1990s, Ford had a successful go at rally competitions with the Ford Escort RS Cosworth. And: the Volkswagen Polo WRC shows its 4x4 skills.

programme.title: Arabella Classics
programme.desc: Rare Automobiles and stunning views! The Arabella Classics, one of the most exclusive Classic Car Rallies in Europe.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Italian super sports cars like the Ferrari La Ferrari, the Lamborghini Aventador or the Pagani Huayra are the most beautiful and fastest cars in the world, created by the best designers. Italian super sports cars are dreams made reality.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: British super sports cars like the Aston Martin Vanquish, the Bentley Continental GT Speed or McLaren's P1 are among the most spectacular and beautiful sports cars in the world. It's not just about power but also grace and style.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Whether it is the Porsche 918 Spyder, the Audi R8, the Mercedes AMG GT or the BMW i8 - German super sports cars are the fastest and most coveted in the world, with their breathtaking top speeds and incredible engine power.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The super sports cars by Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Pagani and Porsche are like Formula One racing cars for the streets, the fastest and most exciting cars in the world, whose power and performance seem to defy the laws of physics.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Ferrari 250 GTO, Porsche 911, Aston Martin DB 5 or Lamborghini Aventador and Ferrari LaFerrari - every era produces fabulous dream cars, born from the fascination for breathtaking design and the dream for outstanding speed.

programme.title: Porsche Cayman GT4
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayman GT4. Lighter, more powerful and faster than ever. Porsche shows what is possible with this vehicle, when fast lap times are in the focus of attention.

programme.title: Porsche Techart Grand GT
programme.desc: The Techart Grand GT may look like Darth Vader's private ride, but it's in fact a souped-up version of the Porsche Panamera.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: Lexus combines luxury with offroad ability in the all-new GX. A Sport derivative joins the Ford Tourneo line-up and Juliet finds out what makes the Audi A3 enjoyable to drive.

programme.desc: We advise a viewer whether or not to buy a 2013 Range Rover Evoque. We search for a bakkie built to handle heavy rain and rocky terrain. And we discuss whether diesel vehicles are suited to frequent short distance driving.

programme.title: NSU Spider

programme.title: Lamborghini Jalpa
programme.desc: Sant'Agata Bolognese, actually just a normal place in Italy. Time seems to stand still in a pleasant way. Everyone knows everyone. And all know Lamborghini. This one goes by the name of Jalpa, it is the last of its kind, the last Lambo with a V8 engine.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: An Bord des Mclaren 570S Spider
programme.desc: Wir fahren mit dem McLaren 570S Spider ein wenig durchs Gebirge und geniessen den schönen Tag.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Mercedes Concept IAA
programme.desc: The Mercedes-Benz “Concept IAA”- Intelligent Aerodynamic Automobile – is two cars in one: an aerodynamics world champion with a Cd value of 0.19 and a four-door coupé embodying irresistible design. The study, which is celebrating its world premiere at the Frankfurt International Motor Show, switches automatically from design mode to aerodynamic mode when the vehicle reaches a speed of 80 km/h.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Wraith
programme.desc: The Rolls Royce Wraith is different. It gives the traditional British brand a whole new dynamic.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Dawn Convertible
programme.desc: Almost silently, it glides through the night. In front of the driver 12 smoothly-running cylinders are at work, with a power reserve that seems inexhaustible. The Rolls Royce Dawn is a convertible for connoisseurs.
